description: Get the full facts for one travel eSIM plan by its id: price in USD, data, validity, daily limit and throttled speed, hotspot / tethering rule, networks, covered and not covered countries, SMS, 5G, top-up, and whether checkout is open. Use it after search_plans when someone asks about a specific plan.

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.

plan_id.description: Plan id exactly as returned by search_plans (the id field of a plan).

name: get_plan
title: Get one eSIM plan's details
